description_expanded: Description Description BEACH ACCESS UPDATE: Due to Hurricane Isaias, there are limited walkovers available in Rosemary Beach. Beach Walkovers A, B, D & E are currently open & accessible. We appreciate your understanding as our community continues to recover.30A ESCAPES presents… “Emerald Green,” a charming coastal retreat tucked into the heart of Rosemary Beach. This spacious 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath home comfortably sleeps 6 and places you just steps from the Coquina Pool and a 2-minute walk from the sugar-white sands of the Gulf. Spend slow mornings with coffee on the front patio, cruise the cobblestone streets on one of the 4 included bikes or gather for dinner on the spacious second-floor balcony after a day at the beach. With inviting interiors, two En-suite bedrooms and Rosemary Beach Town Center just moments away, “Emerald Green” offers an effortless way to experience one of 30A’s most beloved communities. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Prime Rosemary Beach Location just steps from the Coquina Pool and a 2-minute walk to beach accessSleeps 6 Comfortably with 2 spacious bedrooms and 2.5 bathroomsIndoor & Outdoor Living with a welcoming front patio and spacious second-floor balconyChef’s Kitchen with stainless steel appliances, generous prep space and seating for gathering4 Bikes Included for exploring Rosemary Beach and Scenic Highway 30AWalkable to Rosemary Beach Town Center for dining, shopping, coffee and community events*** LIVING AREAS ***Bright and welcoming, the main living space is designed for relaxed time together after days spent exploring Rosemary Beach. Comfortable seating and an open layout make it easy to settle in, while the spacious balcony extends the living area outdoors.Spacious living area with ample seating, flat-screen TV and board gamesOpen-concept layout connecting the living, kitchen and dining spacesDirect access to the second-floor balcony for effortless indoor and outdoor living*** KITCHEN & DINING ***From slow breakfasts before the beach to relaxed dinners at home, the fully equipped kitchen makes gathering around the table easy.Chef’s kitchen with stainless steel appliances and ample counter spaceDining table with seating for 6 plus bar seating for 3Gas grill and al fresco dining for 4 on the spacious balcony*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***With two comfortable En-suite bedrooms on the first floor, “Emerald Green” offers a restful retreat with plenty of privacy for couples, families or a small group of friends.1st FloorPrimary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with single vanity and shower/tub comboQueen Bunk Suite: Queen-over-Queen bunk bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with single vanity and shower/tub combo2nd FloorPowder Room conveniently located off the kitchen*** OUTDOOR SPACES ***Enjoy the charm of Rosemary Beach from two inviting outdoor spaces perfect for everything from quiet mornings to evenings spent together. Sip coffee from the first-floor patio or head upstairs for dinner and drinks beneath the coastal sky.First-floor patio with comfortable seating perfect for morning coffee or evening cocktailsSpacious second-floor balcony with lounge seating and al fresco dining for 4Gas grill for relaxed outdoor meals*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Located along East Water Street in the heart of Rosemary Beach, “Emerald Green” puts the best of the community within easy reach. Walk to the pool, beach and Town Center or hop on a bike and explore Rosemary Beach’s network of boardwalks, green spaces and scenic pathways.Coquina Pool just steps away for an easy afternoon by the waterBeach Access just a 2-minute walk from the homeRosemary Beach Town Center nearby for restaurants, cafés, boutiques and local eventsEastern Green just moments from the beach for open green space and community gatheringsRosemary Beach walking paths and boardwalks winding throughout the communityScenic Highway 30A bike path nearby for exploring Seacrest Beach, Alys Beach and surrounding coastal communities*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentWaiver required to access the 4 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesLSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest or Alys BeachThere are active cameras at the property facing the front and rear patios*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A ESCAPES, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 guest support and an immaculate home designed for comfort, connection and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! *** Read less
